# Policy presets

> **Not legal advice.** Presets are starting points for engineering teams. Whether a
> piece of data is personal information depends on context, purpose and the other
> data it is combined with. Review any preset with your privacy officer or counsel.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py - do not edit by hand. -->

Use a preset to pick which entities to detect:

```python
from canpii import create_analyzer, get_preset

analyzer = create_analyzer()
preset = get_preset("phipa")
analyzer.analyze(text, language="en", entities=preset.entity_list())
```

or to generate a gateway configuration:

```bash
canpii export --format litellm-config --preset phipa
```

## `pipeda` — PIPEDA (federal private sector)

*Jurisdiction:* Canada (federal) · *Law:* <https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/P-8.6/> · *Languages:* en, fr

Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act. Covers information about an identifiable individual collected in the course of commercial activity. The preset targets direct identifiers and government/financial numbers that are routinely redacted before data leaves a controlled environment (e.g. before an LLM call).

Entities: `PERSON`, `EMAIL_ADDRESS`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `CA_SIN`, `CA_POSTAL_CODE`, `CA_PASSPORT`, `CA_DRIVER_LICENSE`, `CA_HEALTH_NUMBER`, `CREDIT_CARD`, `IBAN_CODE`, `CA_BANK_ACCOUNT`, `IP_ADDRESS`, `CA_BN`

Notes:

* CA_BN is included because a sole proprietor's BN can identify an individual; drop it if you only process incorporated-business data.
* LOCATION and DATE_TIME are not included by default: they are noisy, but addresses and birth dates are personal information - add them if your data contains them.

## `phipa` — PHIPA (Ontario health information)

*Jurisdiction:* Ontario · *Law:* <https://www.ontario.ca/laws/statute/04p03> · *Languages:* en, fr

Personal Health Information Protection Act, 2004. Its definition of personal health information expressly includes an individual's health number. The preset is tuned for de-identifying clinical or health-service text: health numbers (OHIP and other provinces), names, contact details, dates and locations.

Entities: `PERSON`, `EMAIL_ADDRESS`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `DATE_TIME`, `LOCATION`, `CA_POSTAL_CODE`, `CA_HEALTH_NUMBER`, `CA_SIN`, `CA_DRIVER_LICENSE`, `CA_PASSPORT`, `MEDICAL_LICENSE`

Notes:

* DATE_TIME and LOCATION are included because dates of service/birth and addresses are classic re-identification vectors in health data; expect more false positives.
* MEDICAL_LICENSE is Presidio's US-oriented built-in; it does not detect Ontario CPSO numbers (see docs/roadmap.md).

## `quebec_law25` — Quebec Law 25 (private sector act, P-39.1)

*Jurisdiction:* Quebec · *Law:* <https://www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca/en/document/cs/P-39.1> · *Languages:* fr, en

Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, as amended by Law 25 (2021, c. 25). Personal information is any information relating to a natural person that allows them to be identified, directly or indirectly; information of a medical, biometric or otherwise intimate nature is sensitive. French is listed first because Quebec data is predominantly French.

Entities: `PERSON`, `EMAIL_ADDRESS`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `CA_SIN`, `CA_POSTAL_CODE`, `CA_PASSPORT`, `CA_DRIVER_LICENSE`, `CA_HEALTH_NUMBER`, `CREDIT_CARD`, `IBAN_CODE`, `CA_BANK_ACCOUNT`, `IP_ADDRESS`, `CA_BN`, `DATE_TIME`

Notes:

* The RAMQ health insurance number (NAM) encodes the holder's name initials, birth date and biological sex, so it is both an identifier and sensitive information.
* DATE_TIME is included because a birth date combined with a name is identifying; remove it if it causes too much noise.
* CA_BN is included for the same reason as in the pipeda preset: a sole proprietor's BN identifies a natural person.

## What presets do not do

* They do not detect free-text health information (diagnoses, medications).
  PHIPA and Law 25 cover far more than identifiers.
* They do not make a dataset "de-identified" or "anonymized" in the legal sense.
* They do not replace a privacy impact assessment.
